android.desc: Track your work hours with one tap. Start the timer when you begin, stop it when you finish, and Timesheet turns it into billable hours, clear statistics and an export your client or your payroll can actually use. Use it as a time clock or as a time card calculator: clock in and out with one tap, or enter start and end times by hand, and Timesheet adds up your hours per day, week and month with breaks taken out. Free to use, with no account required and no time limit. Built and maintained since 2012, on phone, tablet, Wear OS and the web. Time Tracking - One tap starts and stops a work session, online or offline - Manual entries and rounding rules keep past records accurate - Record breaks during a task and read totals with and without break time - Mark a task billable or not, and flag it once it has been billed Projects and Tasks - Organise hours by project and task, with an hourly rate per project - Give a project a client name, an office and a colour to tell them apart - Tags, filters and search keep the work you care about in front - Archive finished projects without losing their history Expenses, Notes and Mileage - Attach reimbursable expenses and receipts to any entry - Add notes to record what was agreed or what comes next - Log mileage and calls alongside the hours they belong to - Capture a signature on site when the work has to be signed off Excel and CSV Export - Build invoice-ready and payroll-ready reports in seconds - Pick a preset or a custom date range before exporting - Share by email, Google Drive or any other business tool Statistics - See time and income per day, week, month or project - Spot unbilled work before it becomes unpaid work Automations - Geofence automation starts or stops the timer when you arrive or leave - Wi-Fi automation reacts to the network at your workplace - NFC tags at a job site switch straight to the right project Widget and Wear OS - Start, pause and stop from the home screen widget - Wear OS app: pick a project and start, pause or stop the timer on your watch - Wear OS tile: pause, resume or stop the running timer with one tap - Wear OS complication: the running time on your watch face, one tap opens the app - The watch app works together with Timesheet on your phone Backup and Restore - Back up to Google Drive, Dropbox or local storage - Restore your full history on a new device in a few steps B
